At 5, this is really common - the move works best with a slow step-down: start by sitting beside him until he's drowsy, then over a week or two shift your chair closer to the door each night until you're gone. A consistent pre-bed routine (same order, same time) is what makes the room feel safe on its own.

Want the full night-by-night plan for moving Milo to his own bed? Reply YES and I'll send it.
